guide.tetanusmod.brewing.body:
Water + Cow Manure makes Cow Manure Potion, causing five seconds of nausea.

Manure Potion + Rust makes Tetanus.
Manure Potion + Infected Meat makes Salmonella.
Manure Potion + Rabid Meat makes Rabies.
Tetanus Potion + Pufferfish makes Lockjaw Sonata.

Gunpowder makes splash potions; dragon breath makes lingering versions.

Smithing, not brewing: leave template empty; arrows in the base slot, Rust in addition. One Rust coats the entire arrow stack, up to 64.
guide.tetanusmod.brewing.title: Brewing
guide.tetanusmod.commands.body:
Operator level 2:
/rustandruin summon minecraft:spider ~ ~ ~
/rustandruin tetanize @e[type=minecraft:zombie,distance=..10]
/rustandruin locate medic
/rustandruin locate tent
/rustandruin locate workshop

Native locate aliases: /locate structure rustandruin:medic_clinic or rustandruin:medic_tent. Clinic results show the actual porch entrance; camp results include the underground entrance. Older command names also work.

/effect give @s tetanusmod:tetanus 300
/effect give @s tetanusmod:rabies infinite
Short disease names also work, such as /effect give @s rabies. Operator commands bypass vaccine prevention.

Population inspection reads loaded chunks only.

Nearby workstations: /locate poi rustandruin:medic or /locate poi rustandruin:medic_tent. POI searches only 128 blocks; use /rustandruin locate tent for a distant camp.
guide.tetanusmod.commands.title: Commands
guide.tetanusmod.crafting.body:
Iron Spear: row 1 empty/iron/iron; row 2 empty/chain/iron; row 3 stick/empty/empty.

Rusted Iron Block: iron block surrounded by four Rust in a cross. The Tetanized Beacon accepts only this base block.

Bear Trap: iron/nail/iron; iron/heavy pressure plate/iron; chain below center. Reset a closed trap with a Trap Reset Tool; you have three seconds to move clear before it rearms. Rusty traps inflict Tetanus.

Barbed Wire: three nails across top and bottom; chain/string/chain across middle.

Medicine Cabinet: iron ingots down both sides, glass panes at top and bottom center, barrel in the center. An unemployed villager can become a medic using it.

Prescription Writer: iron/feather/iron; planks/book/planks; iron/copper/iron. New village clinics and cave medic camps include a writer; Nurses and Nurse Practitioners may also sell one per delivery. Place it, add one paper and one ink sac, and take one Medical Prescription. Treatment trades require emeralds plus a prescription. Medics may sell two emergency prescriptions per village delivery, or one in a cave camp. Nurse treatments are antitoxin or Tetanus Vaccine; Rabies Cure starts at Nurse Practitioner, and Rabies Vaccine and Veterinary Kits start at Medical Doctor. Higher ranks have lower base treatment prices. Native discounts apply; stock still waits for its normal delivery.

Medic supply requests: sneak and right-click any adult medic. The chat tells you the exact item and count. Hold that full amount in your main hand, then sneak and right-click the same medic again. One delivery per medic per world day earns better prices and Special Delivery. These requests are separate from prescription writing.
guide.tetanusmod.crafting.title: Crafting
guide.tetanusmod.creatures.body:
Rusty contact can permanently mutate animals (%s%%) or other ordinary mobs (%s%%). Only permanent tetanized animals replace their ordinary drops with Infected Meat. Temporary Tetanus alone never changes animal loot.

Natural tetanized spawns (Easy/Normal/Hard): animals %s/%s/%s percent; other mobs %s/%s/%s percent. Spawners use %s/%s/%s percent. Withers keep their separate ritual.

Some mammals and undead can be rabid: thirty extra health points, leather-equivalent armor and five-point melee attacks. Rabid animals alone drop Rabid Meat.

Iron golems: %s%% permanent conversion chance from rusty hits. Using Rust directly has a separate eighteen-percent roll.

Use creative variant spawn eggs for specific creatures, or operator commands for testing.

A Veterinary Kit cures a permanently tetanized or rabid animal, restoring its normal appearance, movement and drops. It is single use and costs a golden apple, two antitoxins, Rabies Cure, leather and string.

Finding rabid variants: explore newly spawned creatures in their usual habitats and look for purple-tinted, unusually aggressive mammals or zombie relatives. Wolves, foxes, rabbits, bats, farm mammals and horses are eligible, as are zombies, husks and drowned. Eligible natural/spawner spawns that do not become Tetanized roll a separate Rabid chance: Easy/Normal/Hard %s/%s/%s percent. Rusty weapons make Tetanized variants, not Rabid variants; giving a mob the Rabies effect does not change it into a permanent Rabid variant. For direct testing, use a Rabid spawn egg from the mod's spawn-egg creative tab.
guide.tetanusmod.creatures.title: Creatures
guide.tetanusmod.diseases.body:
Tetanus: random %s-%s seconds. Rusty metal injuries cause stiffness, spasms and movement disturbances.

Lockjaw Sonata blocks eating during the final 2-4 minutes; a standalone potion lasts one minute. Antitoxin cures both.

Raw Infected Meat causes Salmonella: vomiting, nausea, hunger loss and mild nonlethal damage. Cook it first.

Raw Rabid Meat can cause Rabies, with immediate nausea. Rabies lasts until death or Rabies Cure. Each minute removes one heart of capacity, stopping at two hearts; it never deals direct damage. Milk does not cure Rabies.
guide.tetanusmod.diseases.title: Diseases
guide.tetanusmod.overview.body:
Rust changes what iron can do. Build tools, let them weather, then choose whether to clean them or use the infection.

This guide is read-only and never consumed. Choose a chapter on the left. Use the mouse wheel or arrow buttons to scroll.

The server controls duration and protection chances. Diseases, Prevention and Creatures show its current settings. Weapon statistics and ritual examples use defaults.

JEI and REI are optional. All recipes also work without a viewer.
guide.tetanusmod.overview.title: Overview
guide.tetanusmod.prevention.body:
Vaccine: %s%% prevention for %s. Equipped gloves add %s%% rusty-contact prevention; together: %s%%.

Gloves have 192 durability and support Unbreaking and Mending, including repair from XP while in the glove slot. Their appearance is visible on your hands.

Tetanus Protection is a shield enchantment: 65 percent prevention against I, 40 percent against II. Blocking an infectious weapon with it awards Not Today, maybe tomorrow.

Medic clinics roll 55 percent at eligible village locations in newly generated terrain. Cave tents try suitable dry Overworld cave sites at fifteen percent per site, with no second camp within 2,000 blocks. Use /locate structure rustandruin:medic_tent for a distant camp; /locate poi searches only 128 blocks around you. Camp courtyards have fences, two beds, a support farmer, a crop patch and a persistent defender.

Medics progress from Nurse to Nurse Practitioner, Medical Doctor and Attending Physician. Each rank adds two randomized offers. Village medicine stocks contain only two to four doses per item, replenishing at most once per full game-day cycle. Field medics stock at most two per offer and need three cycles between deliveries. Hero of the Village and reputation affect prices.
guide.tetanusmod.prevention.title: Prevention
guide.tetanusmod.salvage.body:
Supported dropped metal rusts in water after five seconds, or fifteen seconds of exposed rain. Names, enchantments and durability survive conversion.

Only permanently tetanized animals drop Infected Meat. Raw infected meat causes Salmonella; raw Rabid Meat can cause Rabies. Cook both before eating.

A wire brush cleans metal and returns one Rust. Use honeycomb to protect clean metal.

A Veterinary Kit treats a mutated animal and produces healing particles and a sound.

Dropped fishing rods break after five seconds in water: two sticks, two string, and a fifteen percent chance of a Rusty Fishing Hook.
guide.tetanusmod.salvage.title: Salvage

guide.tetanusmod.weapons.body:
Iron Spear: three iron ingots, a chain and a stick. Seven base damage, slower than an iron sword. Right-click thrusts up to 4.5 blocks; walls obstruct it. A rusted spear inflicts Tetanus.

Tetanus I applies to melee weapons, bows, crossbows and tridents. Tetanus II also causes disorientation, erratic movement, missed mob attacks and two points of periodic nonlethal damage.

Tetanized arrows alone cause one minute of Tetanus. Enchanted bows cause full-strength infection; using both extends it by 25 percent. Infinity still consumes infected arrows.

Old rusted iron tools keep working in saves but are retired from new acquisition and this creative tab.

guide.tetanusmod.bosses.title: Tetanized bosses
guide.tetanusmod.bosses.body: Four Tetanized Soul Sand blocks roll a 75% Tetanized Wither chance. A netherite block in the top center raises this to 100%. The boss has 650 HP, drops real XP and one Tetanus book: 50% II, otherwise I. It summons up to two 20-HP minions every 30-60 seconds. Forge four special End Crystals (one normal crystal + Rust + a netherite ingot each), then place all four around the End exit portal to summon the 1100-HP Tetanized Dragon. Mixed crystals summon an ordinary dragon. Each victory drops one shared Overload Sword and placeable infected egg; repeat the ritual for more. Sword: 12 damage, 2.3 speed, 4062 durability, Tetanus II. Repair only using netherite blocks at an anvil or Mending.
